name: Gargantilla (Spain)
description: Green field with a white pile issuing from the lower edge to the top, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Gargantilla (a tower, a chequy field and a mount).
history: Municipal flag of Gargantilla; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: pile from the lower corners to the middle of the upper edge
Gargantilla arms — tower, chequy and mount
